We believe that students should have access to the best tools out there. With the Github Student Developer Pack, students can use Termius for free!

Frequently asked questions

Who can apply?

Anyone with an active GitHub Student Developer Pack can get Termius for free.

What will I get?

You will get all the features of Termius Pro and Termius Team, allowing you to synchronize your data with any device and share it with your classmates and friends.
